content.thinking:
The deploy at 07:39:00 changed the cache port from 6379 to 6380, causing connection refused errors that line up exactly with the onset time. Even though the cache is optional by design and the page should work fine without it, latency spiked massively (p50 183ms vs 26ms baseline), suggesting the cache failures are causing blocking waits or timeouts rather than being gracefully skipped.

This fits config-induced-failure perfectly: the deployment altered a config value to point at the wrong port, the source code itself is untouched, and the underlying redis cache is healthy - it's just being addressed incorrectly.

hypotheses.subject: cache.port (io-summary-cache connection config)
hypotheses.summary: The 07:39 deploy changed the io-summary-cache port in values-production.yaml from 6379 to 6380, which is not the address the redis cache listens on, so every cache lookup started failing with connection refused. This drove p50/p95 latency far above baseline (p50 jumped from ~26ms to ~183-192ms) as requests waited on/retried the broken cache connection, timing since the onset lines up exactly with the deploy timestamp.

supporting_evidence.claim: modified deploy/values-production.yaml: cache.port changed from 6379 to 6380
ERROR io-shop: summary cache lookup failed - connection refused to redis://cache.io-shop.svc.cluster.local:6380 (200 of 200 requests)
p50_ms jumps from 26 to 183 and cache_hit_ratio drops from 0.905 to 0.37 then 0.0

hypotheses.subject: io-summary-cache
hypotheses.summary: If the config change were not the cause, the observed pattern (cache connection refused, latency spike, cpu_limit_cores steady at 3.0 throughout) would instead point to the internal io-summary-cache dependency itself failing, but the register describes it as an optional internal cache owned by the same organisation and logs show the failure is a refused connection to a port the deploy itself changed, so this is less likely.

supporting_evidence.claim: ERROR io-shop: summary cache lookup failed - connection refused to redis://cache.io-shop.svc.cluster.local:6380 (121 of 200 requests)
io-summary-cache: internal, owned by checkout-platform, at cache.io-shop.svc.cluster.local
